name: Smooth Motion
description: Generates frames for the display refresh rate or a fixed target frame rate.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.description: Generates frames to the detected display refresh rate.

settings.label: Motion interpolation
settings.description: Generate intermediate frames by blending neighbouring frames with the framerate filter. Disable to leave the video at its source rate. Hardware decoding is paused while the plugin is enabled.

info:
Generates frames with mpv's framerate filter (linear blending).
Open Statistics (I), then press its number key (usually 2).
Settings chooses the display refresh rate or a fixed frame rate.
Hardware decoding is paused while the plugin is enabled: the filter only accepts software frames. The filter is added when the file opens, so playback starts without a hitch.
The on/off shortcut is assigned in Settings → Shortcuts (F9 by default).
